column3: The Hebrew says they came to drink; BSB says they went to dine.
The Hebrew requests her life and her people; BSB explicitly supplies the lives of her people.
The Hebrew names the king’s loss in the final clause; BSB describes burdening the king.
The Hebrew repeats the verb said and refers to someone whose heart emboldened him; BSB compresses the speech introduction and describes devising a scheme.
The Hebrew says the evil was determined against him from the king; BSB describes the king planning a terrible fate.
The Hebrew says Mordecai spoke good concerning the king; BSB specifies a report that saved him.
The Hebrew calls it wood or a tree; BSB specifies gallows.
